addition.item: Update checksum (sha512) in the update feed; automated tests; reproducible build script.
Status filter "Third-party": all extensions that are not Joomla core.

fix.item: False "manifest missing" for components and modules whose manifest has a non-standard file name (e.g. manifest.xml).

addition.item: Safe removal of orphaned component records (all three directories missing, not core, not protected, not in a package), including administrator menu entries; backup first.
Search box above the results table.
Read-only report of other orphaned records (modules, menu items, schemas, update-site links).
Registration in the User Actions Log extension filter.

change.item: Update server and changelog URLs point to the master branch of the public GitHub repository.

fix.item: Restore from backup failed because insertObject() received an expression instead of a variable.

addition.item: Bulk removal of orphaned plugin/library records.
Orphaned update sites panel with removal (backup first).
Restore and delete of backups from the component.
JSON backup of the deleted rows before every removal (administrator/logs).
Repairs and removals are written to the User Actions Log.

change.item: Styled confirmation dialog instead of the native browser confirm box; "Please wait..." overlay during Refresh scan and actions.

addition.item: Safe removal of the database record of an orphaned library (not core, not protected, not in a package, files and manifest missing, not referenced by other extensions).

change.item: Removal messages and confirmation now cover plugins and libraries.

fix.item: False orphan finding for core libraries such as lib_joomla.

addition.item: Joomla core extensions grouped separately and excluded from orphan counts; never offered for repair or removal.

change.item: Two-line name and element cells, uniform row height.
Expand arrow moved to its own first column and made more visible; detail text is clickable.
Compact results table with one line per record; details expand under the row.
Redesigned in the FG visual style (fgcodework.github.io), light and dark.
Status tiles and type pills replace the filter drop-downs.
Status filter is now a row of clickable buttons with record counts.

fix.item: Status and type filters did nothing: script ran in head before the table existed. Now waits for DOMContentLoaded.
Translations not shown after upgrade from 1.1.0: language files are installed to administrator/language again, overwriting the old files.
Invalid CSRF token now redirects with an error message instead of an unhandled exception.

addition.item: Full EN/SK localisation of all texts.
Permissions tab (config.xml); repair and removal require core.admin.
Orphaned plugin record removal also cleans #__schemas and #__update_sites_extensions.
Update server and changelog URL in the manifest.

change.item: Script registered via Web Asset Manager; no inline handlers (CSP friendly).
